scope: Generic actual original F4Run ideal containment and direct negation of unrestricted saturation-member output claim; actual F101 registered Boolean ideal/output rows with explicit saturation witnesses, nonmembership and impossibility of ordinary F4Run containing saturated rows. statement: Lean proves generic ideal containment for the actual original F4Run model, directly refutes its unrestricted extension to saturation outputs, and binds the concrete F101 ordinary/saturated expected rows for I=(xy,x^2-x,y^2-y), with explicit saturation witnesses and y outside I.
